snippet.title: Prince Jackson REACTS to Cousin Jaafar Jackson’s ‘Michael’ Performance
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson opens up in a rare interview with ABC News about the emotional impact of seeing his cousin, Jaafar Jackson, step into the role of his late father in biopic 'Michael,' out now. Prince describes the moment as an 'emotional shock.' He adds that he hopes the film will spark both joy and nostalgia for fans, while also offering a deeper understanding of the pop icon’s life and legacy.
